sentences: Most robots are made of metal and plastic, but a tiny new one from MIT moves with the help of living **muscle** cells.
Its body is a soft gel about the size of a stick of gum, and it has two **fins**, one on each side.
Each fin is covered with a layer of muscle cells, thinner than a human hair, that were **changed** in the lab so that they **tighten** whenever light shines on them.
When light hits one fin, that fin **flaps** and turns the robot to one side, but when light hits both fins, the robot swims forward.
en.answer: 대부분의 로봇은 금속과 플라스틱으로 만들어지지만, MIT가 만든 아주 작은 새 로봇은 살아 있는 근육 세포의 도움을 받아 움직인다.
